title: A fully faithful essentially surjective functor is an equivalence
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category] and $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal D$ a functor. Suppose that for every $X,Y\in\mathcal A$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(X,Y)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(F(X),F(Y))$ induced by $F$ is bijective, and that every object of $\mathcal D$ is isomorphic to $F(X)$ for some $X\in\mathcal A$. Then $F$ is an equivalence: there is a functor $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal A$ with natural isomorphisms $GF\cong\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A}$ and $FG\cong\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal D}$. All categories are small in a common sufficiently large universe.
